datasets.name: dd8fe572
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `bronze`;

SELECT 
    stop_name,
    stop_lat,
    stop_lon,
    avg_delay_min,
    observation_count,
    routes_serving
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.stop_delay_hotspots
WHERE avg_delay_min >= 5
ORDER BY avg_delay_min DESC
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: 7c5255af
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `default`;

SELECT 
    CONCAT(route_name, ' - ', route_long_name) AS route,
    bunching_rate_pct,
    avg_headway_min,
    p95_gap_min,
    bunching_events
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.route_bus_bunching
ORDER BY bunching_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: d18a4e15
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `default`;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN delay_minutes < -1 THEN '1. Early (1+ min)'
        WHEN delay_minutes BETWEEN -1 AND 5 THEN '2. On time (1 early–5 late)'
        WHEN delay_minutes > 5 AND delay_minutes <= 10 THEN '3. Late (5-10 min)'
        WHEN delay_minutes > 10 AND delay_minutes <= 20 THEN '4. Very late (10-20 min)'
        ELSE '5. Severely late (20+ min)'
    END AS delay_category,
    COUNT(*) AS stop_visits
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.stop_level_on_time
WHERE delay_minutes IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN delay_minutes < -1 THEN '1. Early (1+ min)'
        WHEN delay_minutes BETWEEN -1 AND 5 THEN '2. On time (1 mearly-5 late)'
        WHEN delay_minutes > 5 AND delay_minutes <= 10 THEN '3. Late (5-10 min)'
        WHEN delay_minutes > 10 AND delay_minutes <= 20 THEN '4. Very late (10-20 min)'
        ELSE '5. Severely late (20+ min)'
    END
ORDER BY delay_category

datasets.name: 037d6987
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `default`;

WITH routes_with_all_windows AS (
    SELECT route_name
    FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.route_time_of_day_performance
    WHERE fetch_window IN ('7am', '12pm', '5pm')
    GROUP BY route_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fetch_window) = 3
)
SELECT 
    CONCAT(r.route_name, ' - ', r.route_long_name) AS route,
    r.avg_delay_minutes AS avg_deviation_min,
    r.on_time_pct
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.route_on_time_performance r
JOIN routes_with_all_windows w ON r.route_name = w.route_name
WHERE r.total_stop_observations >= 1000
ORDER BY r.avg_delay_minutes DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: 8ad0816d
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `bronze`;

SELECT 
    obs_date,
    ROUND(SUM(is_on_time) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS daily_on_time_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(ABS(delay_minutes)), 2) AS daily_avg_deviation
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.stop_level_on_time
WHERE delay_minutes IS NOT NULL
AND ABS(delay_minutes) <= 60
AND HOUR(actual_arrival) IN (7, 12, 17)
GROUP BY obs_date
ORDER BY obs_date

USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `bronze`;

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT (obs_date, 'EEEE') AS day_of_week,
DAYOFWEEK (obs_date) AS dow_num,
ROUND (SUM (is_on_time) * 100.0 / COUNT (*), 2) AS on_time_pct,
ROUND (AVG (ABS (delay_minutes)), 2) AS avg_deviation
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.stop_level_on_time
WHERE delay_minutes IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT (obs_date, 'EEEE'), DAYOFWEEK(obs_date)
ORDER BY dow_num;

datasets.name: b341d2e9
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `default`;

WITH routes_with_all_windows AS (
    SELECT route_name
    FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.route_time_of_day_performance
    WHERE fetch_window IN ('7am', '12pm', '5pm')
    GROUP BY route_name
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fetch_window) = 3
),
top_routes AS (
    SELECT r.route_name, r.avg_delay_minutes AS overall_deviation
    FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.route_on_time_performance r
    JOIN routes_with_all_windows w ON r.route_name = w.route_name
    WHERE r.total_stop_observations >= 1000
    ORDER BY r.avg_delay_minutes ASC
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT 
    CONCAT(t.route_name, ' - ', t.route_long_name) AS route,
    CASE t.fetch_window 
        WHEN '7am'  THEN 'A. Morning (7am)'
        WHEN '12pm' THEN 'B. Midday (12pm)'
        WHEN '5pm'  THEN 'C. Evening (5pm)'
    END AS fetch_window,
    t.pct_on_time,
    tr.overall_deviation
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.route_time_of_day_performance t
JOIN top_routes tr ON t.route_name = tr.route_name
WHERE t.fetch_window IN ('7am', '12pm', '5pm')
ORDER BY tr.overall_deviation ASC, t.route_name, fetch_window

datasets.name: 6a4fcf26
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `bronze`;

WITH popular_routes AS (
    SELECT route_name, route_rank
    FROM (VALUES
        ('099', 1),
        ('R4',  2),
        ('049', 3),
        ('025', 4),
        ('016', 5),
        ('R6',  6),
        ('R1',  7),
        ('323', 8),
        ('019', 9),
        ('R5',  10)
    ) AS t(route_name, route_rank)
)
SELECT 
    CONCAT(p.route_name, ' - ', t.route_long_name) AS route,
    CASE t.fetch_window 
        WHEN '7am' THEN 'A. Morning (7am)'
        WHEN '12pm' THEN 'B. Midday (12pm)'
        WHEN '5pm' THEN 'C. Evening (5pm)'
    END AS time_window,
    t.pct_on_time
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.route_time_of_day_performance t
JOIN popular_routes p ON t.route_name = p.route_name
WHERE t.fetch_window IN ('7am', '12pm', '5pm')
ORDER BY p.route_rank, time_window

datasets.name: 2c7feb57
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `bronze`;

SELECT 
    CONCAT(route_name, ' - ', route_long_name) AS route,
    avg_scheduled_headway_min AS scheduled_wait,
    avg_actual_headway_min AS actual_wait,
    ROUND(avg_actual_headway_min - avg_scheduled_headway_min, 2) AS slip_min
FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.route_passenger_wait_times
WHERE total_gaps >= 1000
ORDER BY avg_actual_headway_min ASC
LIMIT 15

datasets.name: 98e05cf1
queryLines:
USE CATALOG `bc_transit_ws`;
USE SCHEMA `default`;

SELECT
    delay_category,
    COUNT(*) AS stop_visits
FROM (

    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN delay_minutes < -1 THEN '1. Early (1+ min)'
            WHEN delay_minutes BETWEEN -1 AND 5 THEN '2. On time (1 early-5 late)'
            WHEN delay_minutes > 5 AND delay_minutes <= 10 THEN '3. Late (5-10 min)'
            WHEN delay_minutes > 10 AND delay_minutes <= 20 THEN '4. Very late (10-20 min)'
            ELSE '5. Severely late (20+ min)'
        END AS delay_category

    FROM bc_transit_ws.gold.stop_level_on_time

    WHERE delay_minutes IS NOT NULL

) t

GROUP BY delay_category

ORDER BY delay_category;
